quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who started school after you did?
quests.hint: She reached this school milestone later because she is younger.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister is a girl sibling who started school after you did, since she is younger.
quests.funFact: A younger sibling can still surprise an older one by learning something new first sometimes!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you look out for as your little brother?
quests.hint: He is a brother with fewer years of life experience than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother might be someone you look out for as your little brother.
quests.funFact: A sibling relationship is one of the longest relationships many people will ever have in their life.

quests.instruction: Which family member reached each school milestone, like starting kindergarten, before you did, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He has already experienced being your current age.
quests.explanation: Older Brother reached each school milestone before you did, since he was born earlier.
quests.funFact: Watching an older brother try something new for the first time can make it feel less scary for a younger sibling!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the grandfather of your own mother or father?
quests.hint: He is two generations above your own parent.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is the grandfather of your own mother or father.
quests.funFact: Your parent had their own grandfather growing up, just like you have yours!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your sister who has already experienced being exactly your current age?
quests.hint: Since she is older, she passed through your current age already.
quests.explanation: Older Sister is your sister who has already experienced being exactly your current age.
quests.funFact: Many lifelong friendships between siblings start with simply sharing a bedroom growing up.

quests.instruction: Which family member is the woman your own grandfather grew up calling 'Mom'?
quests.hint: She belongs to the generation above your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is the woman your own grandfather grew up calling 'Mom'.
quests.funFact: Every grandparent you have also grew up with their own parents, just like you did!

quests.instruction: Which word would you use to describe absolutely everyone at a giant reunion of all your relatives?
quests.hint: This word can stretch to include even relatives you rarely see.
quests.explanation: Family is the word you would use to describe everyone at a giant reunion of all your relatives.
quests.funFact: Some family reunions bring together dozens, or even hundreds, of relatives in one place!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares not just your parents, but your exact birth date, and is a boy?
quests.hint: This is more specific than simply being an older or younger sibling.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother shares not just your parents, but your exact birth date too.
quests.funFact: Twins are the only siblings who can never be called simply 'older' or 'younger' by full years!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is both children to their own parents, and parents to you?
quests.hint: This group holds two roles at once: someone's child, and your own parent.
quests.explanation: Parents are both children to their own parents (your grandparents) and parents to you, all at once.
quests.funFact: Every single person in a family tree is someone's child, no matter how old they grow!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the girl your parent calls their own niece?
quests.hint: Think about your own sibling's daughter.
quests.explanation: Niece is the girl your parent also calls their own niece, from their point of view as her aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: The very same girl is called 'niece' by you and possibly 'granddaughter' by your own parents!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares not just your parents, but your exact birth date, and is a girl?
quests.hint: Unlike a regular sibling, her age compared to yours is neither more nor less.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister shares not just your parents, but your exact birth date too.
quests.funFact: Twins are the one kind of sibling pair where neither one ever gets to hold the 'oldest' title for long!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the boy your parent calls their own nephew?
quests.hint: Think about your own sibling's son.
quests.explanation: Nephew is the boy your parent also calls their own nephew, from their point of view as his aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: The very same boy is called 'nephew' by you and possibly 'grandson' by your own parents!

quests.instruction: Which family member group are both children to their own parents, and grandparents to you?
quests.hint: This group holds two roles at once: someone's child, and your grandparent.
quests.explanation: Grandparents are both children to their own parents (your great-grandparents) and grandparents to you, all at once.
quests.funFact: A family tree shows how every person fits into more than one role at the same time!

quests.instruction: Which family member reaches each school milestone, like starting kindergarten, after you did, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She has not yet experienced being your current age.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister reaches each school milestone after you did, since she was born later.
quests.funFact: Younger siblings sometimes get to enjoy family traditions that started only after they were born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who was born after you?
quests.hint: He has lived fewer years than you have.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother is a brother who was born after you.
quests.funFact: The gap in age between two siblings never changes, even as they both grow older.

quests.instruction: Which family member is your brother who has already experienced being exactly your current age?
quests.hint: Since he is older, he passed through your current age already.
quests.explanation: Older Brother is your brother who has already experienced being exactly your current age.
quests.funFact: Many older siblings say they felt especially proud on the day a younger sibling was born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the father of your grandmother or your grandfather?
quests.hint: He belongs to a generation even older than your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is the father of your grandmother or your grandfather.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-grandfather lets you hear stories from even further back in your family's history!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who started school ahead of you?
quests.hint: She reached this school milestone earlier because she is older.
quests.explanation: Older Sister is a girl sibling who started school ahead of you, since she is older.
quests.funFact: A big age gap between siblings can sometimes mean one sibling helps babysit the other.

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman who could tell you what your grandmother was like as a little girl?
quests.hint: She raised your own grandmother.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother could tell you what your grandmother was like as a little girl, since she raised her.
quests.funFact: Hearing childhood stories about your own grandparent can feel like a fun trip back in time!

quests.instruction: Which word covers every relative mentioned so far — parents, siblings, grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, nieces, and nephews?
quests.hint: This is the single biggest umbrella word for all your relatives together.
quests.explanation: Family covers every relative mentioned — parents, siblings, grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, nieces, and nephews.
quests.funFact: No matter how big your family tree grows, the word 'family' always covers everyone on it!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you sometimes look out for the way a big sibling does, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She joined the family a little later than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister might be someone you sometimes look out for the way a big sibling does.
quests.funFact: Being a little sibling often means having someone to look up to right from the start!

quests.instruction: Which family member's birthday falls in a later year than yours, among your own brothers?
quests.hint: He was born in a year after your own birth year.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother's birthday falls in a later year than yours, among your own brothers.
quests.funFact: Some people say a younger sibling ends up teaching them just as much as they teach him!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who has more years of life experience than you?
quests.hint: He was born before you, so he has lived longer.
quests.explanation: Older Brother is a boy sibling who has more years of life experience than you.
quests.funFact: Older siblings often serve as a younger child's very first role model!

quests.instruction: If you trace your family tree back one more branch past your grandparents, whose father do you land on?
quests.hint: Think of the man three generations above you.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather's grandchildren became your own grandparents.
quests.funFact: Tracing a family tree branch by branch is a fun way to discover relatives from long ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who is ahead of you in age, though not necessarily by many years?
quests.hint: Even a single year makes her older than you.
quests.explanation: Older Sister is a sister who is ahead of you in age, whether by many years or just one.
quests.funFact: Some families have children spaced many years apart, while others have them close together.

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who has fewer years of life experience than you?
quests.hint: She was born after you, so she has lived for less time.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister is a girl sibling who has fewer years of life experience than you.
quests.funFact: Younger siblings sometimes pick up new words and habits by copying an older sibling!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who has fewer years of life experience than you?
quests.hint: He was born after you, so he has lived for less time.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother is a boy sibling who has fewer years of life experience than you.
quests.funFact: A sibling only a year or two apart in age often becomes a very close childhood friend.

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who started school ahead of you?
quests.hint: He reached this school milestone earlier because he is older.
quests.explanation: Older Brother is a boy sibling who started school ahead of you, since he is older.
quests.funFact: A younger sibling can look forward to reaching the very same milestones an older sibling already passed!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man three generations above you on a family tree?
quests.hint: He is even further back than your own grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is a man three generations above you on a family tree.
quests.funFact: Not everyone gets to meet a great-grandfather, so it can be an extra special connection!

quests.instruction: Which family member might sometimes look out for you the way a big sibling does, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She has been part of the family a little longer than you.
quests.explanation: Older Sister might sometimes look out for you the way a big sibling does.
quests.funFact: Family birth order can sometimes influence which chores or responsibilities each child takes on.
